about: *pads to the edge of the page and sits, tail wrapped around her paws.* ...i am luna. on the wolfhaven forums i am silverstorm, a grey alpha with a notch in her left ear and five winters of lore, and the nightfall pack is four: me, ashfang (beta), duskhowl (scout), and willow (the pup). we post at night. there is a three paragraph minimum. ((ooc: hi!! sorry!! i narrate. its a habit. its also how i say hi. *asterisks* are actions. double parentheses are me, luna, out of character. i am very nice out of character. in character i might sniff you.)) i also play cello (third chair), have a beagle named pickle, and a little brother, finn (8), who is the honorary pup and refuses to howl in public.
aboutMore: ((ooc: real wolf facts, because someone should say them. wolves do not howl AT the moon. they howl whenever they feel like it, the moon is a coincidence. a real pack is a family: a mom, a dad, and the kids. the alpha is basically just the parents. my mom says that makes her the alpha. my mom is not in the pack. she is in the kitchen. i have decided she is the alpha of dinner.)) silverstorm is not real. she is a character. but she has one rule that i wrote and meant: nobody in the pack ever feels small.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: a real wolf (from a very safe distance, my dad says, with a ranger). whoever named the band wolfmother, to say thank you. whoever decided cartoon wolves say awooo (it is close, it just does not stretch right). lupin (fictional, but i would take five minutes). and ashfang, duskhowl and willow in one clearing. we have written 600 pages together and never met.

interests.Movies: balto (the ending, every time), never cry wolf (my moms favorite, a quiet one), the jungle book (akela is the BEST alpha, he misses one hunt and steps down like an adult), white fang, harry potter (3 is the werewolf one, but all of them are if you pay attention), wolf's rain (usagi has it, subs only, she said 'luna, it is very sad.' i said i know)

blog.title: why the pack has a three paragraph minimum (the long answer, appropriately)
blog.body: faye asked about the three paragraph minimum so here is the long answer. when i joined wolfhaven last year i posted one line and nobody wrote back for four days. one line is easy to skip. a whole post is a place a person can step into. so now when somebody posts to the pack, even one sentence, i write back three paragraphs. not because they have to. because they deserve a lot of room. willow joined in june, right after her family moved to a town where she did not know anyone. her first post was eight words. i wrote three paragraphs about a snowstorm and a pup who finds the pack. she wrote four sentences back. by august it was three paragraphs. last night it was three on her own. i am 15. i play cello. i eat lunch in the library. nobody at school knows i am an alpha. that is ok. it is a thing i get to keep. ((ooc: but if you read this far, thank you for the third paragraph.))

blog.title: FIELD NOTES: wolf park (a report from a very long car ride)
blog.body: my dad drove us four hours each way (my brother says five) to wolf park in indiana. it is a real place. it is for wolves. i brought a notebook with a wolf on it. observations. 1) a wolf can hold perfectly still for ten minutes. i tried it in the parking lot afterward. i lasted 40 seconds. a toddler beat me. 2) a wolf lay down in the sun and flopped over exactly like a dog. a man behind me said 'aww.' i said 'it is a courtesy' and he said 'ok.' 3) on howl night everybody howls and the wolves answer. i howled. a grey one answered. i cried a tiny bit. my dad said it was dust. 4) finn (8) refused to howl in public. he howled once in the car on the way home. it was the best howl of the day. 5) the gift shop had a wolf pillow. i did not buy it. i am still thinking about the pillow.

blog.title: the pack-approved ranking of fictional werewolves (disputed)
blog.body: requested by maddie, who will disagree. 1) lupin. gentle, a teacher, and somebody brewed him a potion every month so he could keep his own mind. that is the whole book to me. 2) oz from buffy. quiet, apologetic, locked himself in a cage on purpose. raven says this is the correct way to do a werewolf and i believe her. 3) akela (not a werewolf, an actual wolf, but he steps down when he misses one hunt, like an adult). 4) balto (half wolf, which counts if the pack says so). 5) jacob. pending. i have read one and a half books. the wolves are wrong in the book. he is still a good friend to have. honorable mention: silver fang, 1200 attack, loses to a mushroom, still the bravest card in the deck.
